sections.markdown:
## A — Exam authority for the night driving, driving situations, emergencies, vehicle failures and crashes section (New Jersey Class D basic license knowledge test)
Issuer: the New Jersey Motor Vehicle Commission (MVC) publishes the New Jersey Driver Manual, which prepares applicants for the knowledge portion of the driver test [A01].
Source document: New Jersey Driver Manual, with 2026 printed on the front cover [A02].
Knowledge test: 50 questions, plus a survey question about organ donation [A03].
Passing standard: 80 percent, which means 40 of the 50 questions must be answered correctly [A04].
Vision screening is required for every motorist, and basic license applicants need 20/50 vision with or without corrective lenses [A04].
Time limit: the manual does not state one, so it stays unknown and is never shown to learners (verify NJ-EMER-A-TIME).
This section feeds the knowledge test: the night stopping table and headlight rules, looking twelve seconds ahead in the city, uncontrolled intersections, highway and road hazards, doubled work zone fines, the ignition lock rule, skid recovery, emergency stops and warning devices, running off the pavement, car fires, submerged vehicles, stalling on railroad tracks, brake, tire, steering, headlight, gas pedal, hood and wiper failures, stop-turn-speed-up crash avoidance, crash types and crash reporting.
Practice quizzes follow the product mastery policy from the learning loop, which is not an official exam threshold.

format.value: Knowledge test of 50 questions plus an organ-donation survey question, offered in English, American Sign Language and listed foreign languages, with an oral headphone version for applicants who cannot read; separate vision screening and road test

corpus_stability.reason: The New Jersey Driver Manual prints 2026 on its front cover and a single back-cover code; the identification charts carry one revision note (Revised 4/2026) and the manual says fees are subject to change, with no sign of more than one rewrite per year in the selected pages.

verification_debt.claim_text: The New Jersey Driver Manual states no time limit for the knowledge test; an official MVC source is required before any value is shown.
